source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new regression file creates one-message and three-message folders, archives the selected messages, and checks that the corresponding single or multimessage browser is hidden. It retains both scenarios in accepted source. Those visibility assertions support the user-visible clearing symptom, but do not by themselves inspect the hidden content, collapsed-pane path or assistive-technology state. Proposed tests extending this family should choose the prior display mode explicitly. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.
title: Message-pane archive tests cover both previous display modes
